checks.detail: Summary, ranking, cache and details are unconditional presentation sections; unsupported notice is separate.
Initial status drives per-section loading; summary receives null readings before data exists. No page-wide loading replacement supplied.
A non-503 fatal failure has section retry callbacks to the same read query; callback presence is not tested interaction.
Retained data keeps fatalError null, so populated sections stay mounted. Shared source notice exposes refresh failure and source retry; summary labels retained evidence.

Paused is explicitly classified rather than invented server failure. Initial paused leaves loading shells plus source notice; retained paused leaves rows and warning/retry. Native offline rendering NOTRUN.
Order/limit key the read; 30-second poll and 15-second stale time are actual constants. Top-N scope and unknown observation bounds are explicit, not a complete historical window.

Table page size 25/50/100 is distinct from fetched limit 10/25/50/100. Pagination slices filtered loaded rows and reports filtered count, not invented server total. Data-length/filter/search changes reset page; selection of a different server order is not table-column sorting.

Scope selectors stay usable in error/loading. Shared refresh is disabled while fetching; loaded-row export is disabled with no filtered/selected rows. No query execution, write mutation, reset or chart fullscreen/export is offered by the inspected page.
Exact PowerShell canonical-and-split lookups found orderMean/orderTotal/orderCalls/orderMax missing; other locales/runtime bundle loading NOTRUN.

Selectors have localized visible/ARIA labels; chart supplies full fingerprints/value columns to shared accessible fallback; progressbars are named and show numeric percentages. DOM/screen-reader acceptance remains NOTRUN.
Historical audit's sm=36px candidate is no longer current: sm now has min-h-11 below md and md:min-h-9. This closes only the source-size concern, not actual native width/spacing/focus.

Actual case-sensitive Select-String counts: static CSS-variable inline style 0; raw controls 0; direct chart/map/motion vendor imports 0; old API imports 0; neon text 0; fixed-white text 0; any type 0. Actual request prefix/camelCase-param violations 0; two /api/v1 hits are documentation. This is not a full audit-script or compiler pass.

Existing explicit PostgreSQL millisecond wire fields are not renamed or converted in hooks. Seconds conversion is for the existing latency display contract only. No telemetry/model/unit migration is authorized by this report.
Inspected page/direct feature dependency sources introduce no RUM bootstrap or production payload logging. Backend observability instrumentation is not audited.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Both optional nullable counters are independently replaced by zero before a positive-denominator percentage is declared known. The aggregate repeats the same substitution, then the summary publishes that percentage when the envelope exists.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only counterexample, NOT executed: one otherwise valid row with shared_blks_hit=null and shared_blks_read=10 yields 0%; hit=10 and read=null yields 100%. Both are accepted by the TypeScript type but neither ratio is fully observed. No SQL text or real payload is needed.
confirmedIssues.expected: Unknown ratio remains unknown whenever a required counter is absent; aggregate explicitly accounts for incomplete evidence.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow cache-evidence correction in the existing helper/controller/summary path; do not rename wire fields or invent missing counters.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-023/MDC-043: all mobile details remain reachable
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Caller allow-lists only fingerprint/mean/calls. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to the other four fields. No mobilePresentation, expandable/renderExpanded, row action or alternate full detail is supplied. The column menu cannot override the independent mobileSet.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-defined scenario, NOT native tested: below 768px with ordinary loaded rows, max_time_ms, total_time_ms, rows_returned and cache are hidden. Horizontal scrolling does not reveal display:none cells. A top-eight cache panel or top-twelve selected-metric chart is not an equivalent per-row detail alternative.
confirmedIssues.expected: Every original row field and associated controls remain reachable on mobile.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow caller adoption of the existing full-detail mobile presentation contract, or preserve all columns through contained horizontal scrolling; keep tableId, filters, paging and export semantics.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-033: no fabricated measurement for an empty sample
confirmedIssues.mechanism: maxMean and maxPeak start at zero and remain zero for an empty list. hasData denotes the response envelope, not a measured query. Summary passes those zeros as valid latency readings whenever known=true.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only counterexample, NOT executed: a successful envelope with slow_queries=[] gives known=true, count=0, maxMean=0, maxPeak=0. The two maxima are therefore published as measured zero-second latency despite no query observation.
confirmedIssues.expected: Known zero query/count aggregates may remain zero; slowest mean and peak of no observations must be unknown.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow empty-maxima correction preserving metric numeric APIs and the known-zero count distinction.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044 / frontend SI cutover: fallback English must exist in canonical catalogs
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Four order options request translation keys absent from both canonical en.json and its locale-admin projection. Dropdown and active metric titles depend on these options, so fallbacks hide the missing resource ownership.
confirmedIssues.repro: Actually checked without rendering: extract literal admin.* keys from the six exact feature files and traverse each dotted key in canonical and split JSON. 46 checked, 42 found, these four missing.
confirmedIssues.expected: All four canonical option labels exist under the keys used by the page; generated projections stay coherent.
confirmedIssues.fix: A separately owned, serialized catalog-only correction at existing canonical/projection owners; this worker makes no catalog edits.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: filtered no-match differs from authoritatively empty
confirmedIssues.mechanism: A loaded nonempty source mounts DataTable with local search/value filters. When filteredData is empty, DataTable emits the caller's unconditional No slow queries copy, the same assertion used for an actually empty source.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-defined scenario, NOT browser tested: start with any loaded row, enter a search with no match or choose an excluding value filter. filteredData=[] while source data is nonempty; body shows No slow queries and summary remains populated.
confirmedIssues.expected: No matching queries for the current table filters, with the original source-empty explanation reserved for authoritatively empty rows.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow caller empty-message correction preserving the existing loaded-row filter pipeline and search controls; no new server filter capability.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: unsupported evidence is not empty evidence
confirmedIssues.mechanism: An initial configured-missing 503 sets subsystemMissing=true, showError=false and rows=[]. Analysis is not told the unsupported state, so ranking/cache render ordinary data-empty messages. Details skips its meaningful source-empty branch because subsystemMissing=true, then mounts an empty DataTable asserting No slow queries.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-defined scenario, NOT API/browser tested: initial ApiError with status503 and code SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED, no retained data. An unsupported banner coexists with No queries to chart yet, No shared-buffer statistics and No slow queries, although no statistics read succeeded.
confirmedIssues.expected: All section shells stay visible but identify the unsupported/not-measured source rather than asserting measured absence.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow unsupported-state propagation across the existing controller/analysis/details path; keep independent shells and shared feedback.
